winter.headline: Hokkaido's Finest
winter.tagline: Where precision meets powder. The world's deepest snow, guided by its most experienced hands.

summer.headline: Alpine Summer
summer.tagline: Crystal water, volcanic coastline, open sea. Hokkaido's summer — from the water up.

services.sectionSubtitle: Engineered for those who demand more from the mountain.

techAnalysis.title: Snow Science & Tech Analysis
techAnalysis.description: Pre-tour snowpack briefings using live data, terrain mapping, and atmospheric modelling. Know your mountain before you ride it.

backcountry.title: Backcountry Guiding
backcountry.description: Expert-led off-piste and backcountry access across Niseko, Rusutsu, Teine, Kiroro, and Furano. Lines no one else will show you.

concierge.title: Elite Concierge
concierge.description: Heliski permits, private onsen access, kaiseki reservations, and luxury lodge coordination. Seamless from arrival to departure.

deepPowder.title: Deep Powder Specialist
deepPowder.description: Timing is everything. Our storm-chasing intelligence and terrain knowledge position you for the deepest days of the season.

safety.title: Safety & Rescue
safety.description: AIARE-certified guides, full rescue kit, real-time beacon protocols, and comprehensive pre-tour safety briefings included on every tour.

photography.title: Photography Guiding
photography.description: Dedicated photography tours designed for the shot. Golden hour positioning, location scouting, and patience to wait for the moment.

sup.title: Stand-Up Paddleboarding
sup.description: Guided SUP sessions on the gin-clear waters of the Shakotan Peninsula. Full coaching from our ACA-certified instructor — beginners to advanced.

seaKayaking.title: Sea Kayaking
seaKayaking.description: Paddle through dramatic sea caves and along Cape Kamui's volcanic cliffs. Shakotan's coastline is one of Hokkaido's best-kept secrets.

boatCharter.title: Private Boat Charter
boatCharter.description: Licensed skipper, private vessel, your itinerary. Explore the Shakotan Peninsula from the water — snorkelling stops, hidden coves, and open-sea running.

coastal.title: Coastal Exploration
coastal.description: Combined sea and shore experiences: swimming, snorkelling, cliff walks, and rock pooling along one of Japan's most scenically unspoiled coastlines.

concierge.title: Summer Concierge
concierge.description: Boutique guesthouse bookings, fresh seafood reservations at Shakotan's best restaurants, and curated transport logistics across the Hokkaido coast.

photography.title: Photography Guiding
photography.description: Sea-level and aerial perspectives on the Shakotan coast. Position yourself for the extraordinary frame — on the water or from the clifftop.

team.sectionSubtitle: A small, elite roster. No junior guides. Every booking is led by a senior professional.
